recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current build already reflects FHIR-15027 through the later availability datatype model, so editing the source would be redundant and risks drifting from later availability decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-15027 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for STU3 asking that PractitionerRole.availableTime and PractitionerRole.notAvailable describe when the practitioner is available or unavailable while performing the role at a location and/or healthcare service, rather than describing a service site or HealthcareService.
initial_application: Commit 35f38f5e1a5a505af1480eeaf060a64de0df5cd5, 'Tracker 15027 updated availableTime and notAvailable', replaced the old Service Site and HealthcareService definitions in source/practitionerrole/practitionerrole-spreadsheet.xml with the practitioner-focused wording requested by the issue.
additional_context: Later Published PA work in FHIR-25381 replaced PractitionerRole.availableTime, PractitionerRole.notAvailable, and availabilityExceptions with PractitionerRole.availability using the shared Availability datatype. source/fhir.ini keeps PractitionerRole active and maps the old paths to PractitionerRole.availability and PractitionerRole.availability.notAvailableTime. FHIR-32500 subsequently added rendering guidance to the availability comment. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current active source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml definition for PractitionerRole.availability says the practitioner is available or performing the role at the location and/or healthcare service, and its comment explains not-available periods as times when the practitioner is not available. Current PractitionerRole source contains no stale Service Site or HealthcareService availability phrasing.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the shared Availability datatype and replaced PractitionerRole.availableTime/notAvailable with PractitionerRole.availability while preserving the corrected scope.
Added rendering guidance to PractitionerRole availability comments after the FHIR-15027 wording had already been applied.
